title: Morphisms of schemes descend along an fpqc covering $\{X\to S\}$ (Stacks 02W0)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] such that the one-member family $\{f:X\to S\}$ is an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Put $X_2=X\times_SX$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]) with projections $\mathrm{pr}_0,\mathrm{pr}_1:X_2\to X$. For a scheme $U$ with a morphism $U\to S$ write $U_X=U\times_SX$, a scheme over $X$ by the second projection, and let $\mathrm{can}_U:\mathrm{pr}_0^*U_X=U_X\times_{X,\mathrm{pr}_0}X_2\to U_X\times_{X,\mathrm{pr}_1}X_2=\mathrm{pr}_1^*U_X$ be the isomorphism of schemes over $X_2$ obtained by composing the canonical isomorphisms of both sides with $U\times_SX_2$ (they exist since $f\circ\mathrm{pr}_0=f\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$). For a morphism $\alpha:U\to W$ of schemes over $S$ write $\alpha_X=\alpha\times_S\mathrm{id}_X:U_X\to W_X$. Then for any two schemes $U,W$ over $S$ the map $\alpha\mapsto\alpha_X$ is a bijection from the set of morphisms $U\to W$ over $S$ onto the set of morphisms $\beta:U_X\to W_X$ over $X$ satisfying $\mathrm{can}_W\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\beta=\mathrm{pr}_1^*\beta\circ\mathrm{can}_U$ (where $\mathrm{pr}_k^*\beta=\beta\times_{X,\mathrm{pr}_k}\mathrm{id}_{X_2}$).
